title: Batch Gaussian boundary right-hand sides to reduce their cost
body:
The retained Gaussian phase-cell inverse applies one banded boundary matrix to many independent tensor lines. This groups a power-of-two number of right-hand sides and uses exact Strassen products for blocked triangular solves, Woodbury correction and sparse cell couplings. The conditional boundary factor drops from `w^2` to `w^(log_2(7)-1)`.

The proof pays for RHS grouping, single-field padding, table scans, ragged blocks, cyclic endpoints and returns. A residual bound independent of the number of cells retains O(p) precision. The exact inequality `7^16 < 2^45` gives the conservative boundary margin `(3+29r)/32-delta`, replacing `r-delta`.

**No new kappa is claimed.** Per-axis Gaussian work, small-field exposure, `epsilon+r<1`, normalizations and supplier/assembly contracts remain. This follows #475 and #479 in removing a separate outer cost; changing only this row leaves the current selected minimum unchanged.

New package: `research/batched-gaussian-boundary/`. Run `python -B research/batched-gaussian-boundary/verify.py /absolute/new/output`. Checks cover 15 signed/near-singular/degenerate cyclic systems, two actual Gaussian-derived Schur systems, 2,781 inverse entries, 2,952 complete Schur comparisons, exact Strassen operation counts, 54 split/interleave layouts and six non-vacuous mutations. Complete Schur checks use the new rounded boundary/coupling program with an **exact dense local inverse reference**; the inherited GS rounding argument remains a dependency.

Fresh macOS Python 3.11.15/3.14.8 and Linux Python 3.12.3 wrappers passed with byte-identical complete CHECKS and RESULT artifacts. Twelve source pins are checked against parent Git bytes. Validation records include the initial Linux launch-path and archive-metadata failures; neither executed the mathematical checks. The successful Linux run uses the unchanged source manifest and a metadata-free archive. GitHub CI is separate.

The all-size analytic and fixed-tape transfer is a written conditional argument, not established by the finite checks. No new Lean proof, unconditional multiplication theorem, runtime benchmark or optimality claim. Existing source files are unchanged.

Credits: the retained RaD/hipotures phase-cell and bulk-resampling reports and their cited Gaussian interfaces; Strassen's seven-product identity; the inherited supplier work cited by #475/#479. New batching, accounting and controls by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
